pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify Prior Order History Before Claiming Past Details
lesson.when: A customer references a previous interaction or order without prior conversation history or tool evidence provided in context
lesson.do: Ask for necessary details or check verified source data before stating specific past order numbers or previous discussion details
lesson.otherwise: Express uncertainty about past interaction details instead of inventing unverified order numbers or previous topics
